title: APCSV-2025-6834-ZC-SPPC
text:
APCSV-2025-6834-ZC-SPPC  Council District: 4 – Raman
  CEQA: ENV-2025-6835-CE  Last Day to Act: 08-31-26
  Plan Area: Encino – Tarzana

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  17317 – 17323 West Ventura Boulevard; (5025 North Louise Avenue)

  PROPOSED PROJECT:

  The proposed project is a Zone Change from (Q)C4-1VL to (T)C4-1VL and entails the removal of the (Q)
  Qualified Classification, which currently applies to a portion of the site situated approximately 170 feet north
  of the Ventura Boulevard right-of-way and extends to the remainder of the site to allow medical clinic, office
  or service facility uses. The (Q) Qualified Classification restricts medical clinic, office or service facility uses.
  The project proposes a change of use of 11,911 square feet of general office to medical clinic, office or
  service facility uses.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15301, (Class 1), an
  exemption from CEQA and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  Categorical Exemption, pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2, applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.4 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Zone Change
  from (Q)C4-1VL to (T)C4-1VL; and
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.2, and Ventura-Cahuenga Boulevard Corridor Specific
  Plan, Section 9, a Project Compliance to permit the change of use of 11,911 square feet of office space
  to medical office.

  Applicant:  17323 Ventura Prop., LLC
  Representatives: Agustin Sevilla and Kevin Kohan, Elevated Entitlement, LLC

  Staff:  Adrineh Melkonian, City Planner
